summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest, 21 tests) + frontend (Playwright E2E) testing of AURA Campus platform. Backend: 21/21 passed. Frontend: all critical flows for CR, Student, and Admin personas verified — login/logout, announcement composer gating (CR posts, Student blocked with lock message), attendance add/mark, anonymous query create with enc_usr_ id + active/archived tabs, clubs list with 5-year archives toggle, temp group creation, complaint filing, admin role panel list + role change with persistence across reload.

minor.issue: Pydantic EmailStr silently lowercases the email; register response returns lowercased email even though caller sent uppercase. Not a bug per se but worth documenting. No user-facing impact since login normalizes too.

ui_bugs.issue: The <select> uses defaultValue={u.role} instead of value={u.role}. After a role change the badge (Current role column) updates via re-render, but the dropdown's visible selection can appear stale until the component fully remounts. Cosmetic only — the backend value is correct (verified via reload).

issues: Console emits two 401s for /api/auth/me before login. Harmless (that's how the AuthContext bootstraps) but noisy — consider suppressing 401 from /api/auth/me client-side logs.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In AdminPanel, use `value={u.role}` (controlled) instead of `defaultValue` to keep dropdown UI in sync when user role changes without reload.
OPTIONAL: Silence /api/auth/me 401 on unauth boot to reduce console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: seed_admin-like pattern is idempotent-only-if-missing. If demo passwords are ever changed in code, existing seeded users won't be re-hashed. Consider upserting password_hash on startup.
server.py: /api/queries GET performs sequential await inside a loop when auto-archiving; fine for small datasets but could be batched.
server.py: uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). FastAPI recommends `lifespan` context. Non-blocking.

server.py: CORS `allow_origins` includes '*' via FRONTEND_URL fallback which will conflict with `allow_credentials=True` if FRONTEND_URL is unset. Currently OK because the hard-coded preview URL is present.
App.js (~1080 lines) mixes 8 feature components in one file — exceeds 700-line guideline; consider splitting into per-feature modules.
AdminPanel dropdown uses uncontrolled defaultValue leading to visual drift after role change (see UI bug).
test_credentials: See /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all 7 seeded personas login OK.
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_ prefixed announcements, attendance subjects, queries, temp groups, and complaints. Non-destructive; safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 21 backend endpoints verified via pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Frontend E2E covered CR/Student/Admin personas across all 8 nav sections. Only cosmetic issues remain (admin dropdown value binding + console 401 noise). Feature parity with review_request is 100%.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues found. Initial admin-panel 'No users found' observation during the first Playwright run was a test-timing race; API returned 200 with all users when given an extra ~1s wait after nav-admin click (confirmed via response listener showing 200 on /api/admin/users).
